about_the_game:
COMPLETE PACK
  • 3990 Platinum
  • CALIBAN PRIME: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
  • VENATO PRIME: Fashioned from the willingly-donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against “common enemies” of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.
  • VADARYA PRIME: Caliban Prime's signature sniper rifle is no mere ceremonial weapon. A sign, perhaps, that peace between Orokin and Sentient was destined to be fleeting. Struck enemies become lightning rods, with a chance to attract bolts of chain lightning that can jump to nearby enemies.
  • NEUROVYRE PRIME SYANDANA: Painstakingly embellished with scavenged gold as a treaty gift for the Orokin, this Sentient spinal symbiote serves as Caliban Prime’s signature syandana.
  • TAURON PRIME REGALIA: The Tauron Academy uniform blends Tenno functionality with Sentient design.
  • EXCLUSIVE CALIBAN PRIME GLYPHS
  • 90-Day Affinity Booster
  • 90-Day Resource Booster

Prime Warframes and Weapons in Prime Access can also be crafted from parts found in Relics in-game.

This pack can only be purchased once per account. This pack can only be purchased as part of a bundle.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *:Windows 7 64-Bit (32-bit not supported)
  • Processor:Intel Core i7 860, Intel Core i5 750, or AMD FX-4100 (SSE 4.2 support required)
  • Video:DirectX 11+ capable Graphics Card
  • Memory:4 GB RAM
  • Storage:50 GB available HD space
  • Internet:Broadband Internet Connection Required

Note: There is no Mac or Linux client currently available.

DirectX 12 support requires at least Windows 10 20H2 (released in 2020) or Windows 11

short_description: Add a full suite of the Orokin's finest to your Arsenal instantly. The Complete Pack includes 3990 Platinum, Caliban Prime, Venato Prime, Vadarya Prime, Caliban Prime Accessories, 90-Day Affinity and Resource Boosters and much more.
supported_languages:
English*, German, French, Italian, Korean, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Thai
*languages with full audio support
